7. On due consideration, same is allowed and deficit Court fee is taken on record.

sentences.text: It is submitted by Shri Rahul Kumar Tripathi, learned counsel for the appellant that learned Tribunal has considered age of Gaytri as 30 years on the basis of medical documents.
Her date of birth has come on record as 01.12.1982.
Date of accident is 05.06.2013.
Thus, she has not completed 31 years of age, therefore, Tribunal has not erred in considering her her age to be 30 years.

Gaytri vs Keshav Das on 13 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/135852471/
2 10.

Another ground which is raised in this appeal is that learned Tribunal has considered notional income of Gaytri at Rs.3,000/- per month, whereas on the date of the accident, minimum wages even for an unskilled labourer were to the tune of Rs.5,270/- per month.
11.

Thus, when income of Gaytri at Rs.5,270/- per month or Rs.63,240/- per annum is taken into consideration and the Tribunal has construed cent percent disability and has applied multiplier of 17 but Tribunal has not added 40% towards Future prospects, which is when added, will take total pecuniary compensation to Rs.15,05,112/-.
Over and above which, Tribunal has awarded a sum of Rs.1,75,839/- under the head of Treatment, which when added will take total compensation to Rs.16,80,951/- against a sum of Rs.7,87,839/-.

Thus, there will be enhancement to the tune of Rs.8,93,112/- (Rupees Eight Lakhs, Ninety Three Thousand, one hundred and twelve only) to which claimants will be entitled to in addition to the amount awarded by the learned Claims Tribunal.

13. Since appeal is valued only at Rs.5,00,000/-(Rupees Five Lakhs only) and Court fee has been accordingly paid, therefore, claimants will be entitled to interest @ 6% per annum from the date of filing of the claim petition till the date of actual payment on this additional amount of Rs.5,00,000/-
(Rupees Five Lakh only).
Since Court fee on the remaining amount of Rs.3,93,112/- (Rupees Three Lakh, Ninety Three Thousand, One Hundred and Twelve only) is being paid today, interest @ 6%
will be payable on the remaining amount of Rs.3,93,112/- (Rupees Three Lakh Ninety Three Thousand, One Hundred and Twelve only) from today till the date of actual payment.
Other terms and conditions of the award shall remain intact.
14. This additional amount along with accrued interest shall remain invested in the Monthly Income Scheme of the Indian Post Office or a Nationalized Bank for a period of ten years.
The claimants will be entitled to utilize its monthly interest for their well being and maintenance, but the principal amount will not allowed to be withdrawn for a period of ten years.
15. In above terms, this miscellaneous appeal is disposed of.
16. Record of the Claims Tribunal be sent back.
(VIVEK AGARWAL) JUDGE pp Gaytri vs Keshav Das on 13 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/135852471/
